# Compose theme experiment

This records the original Compose experiment. The current implementation extends
it into selectable workspace appearances; see [Workspace appearances](../workspace-themes/README.md).

References generated with the built-in imagegen tool before implementation.

Prompt direction: a readable desktop Mailloop Compose workspace, Vercel-inspired
white / near-black surfaces, subtle 1px borders, system sans, 6px corners,
Inngest coral monospace section labels, blue links and focus, semantic status
colors. Compact Compose heading, horizontal navigation, message and shortlist
on the left, personal preview and send queue on the right. No purple, gradients,
or decorative illustration. Generate light and dark as separate images.

The implementation follows the references' palette, hierarchy, spacing, and
controls. Existing recipient role inputs, sending estimates, checklist, and
quota behavior take priority over invented controls in the generated references.
The existing estimate ring is retained to preserve its status information.

Compose content rules use `.compose-page`. Shell tokens follow the navigation
`data-compose-page` marker, because Next.js can retain inactive pages in hidden
Activity trees. Native dialogs inherit the tokens; Premium tooltips portal into
the scoped main element. The saved theme toggle and preference stay shared.

## Verification

Passed `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, and all 5 tests in
`npm test -- tests/redesign.test.ts`.

All 24 targeted browser checks passed across desktop and mobile projects,
using the existing disposable PostgreSQL runner. Coverage includes sending
individual emails, templates, attachments, bulk selection, exhausted and stale
quotas, exact-capacity sends, and Premium dialogs in both themes. Compose was
captured at 1440×1100, 1280×800, and 390×844 in both themes. Accessibility scans,
viewport overflow, responsive columns, dialog dismissal and focus restoration,
and restoration of the existing shell after navigation passed.

The browser command was:

```sh
npx tsx scripts/test-usage-db.ts --e2e-only '--browser=app.spec.ts,feature-gates.spec.ts,--grep,compose theme|send-limit popup|send-limit boundary|individual campaign queue|attachment defaults|compose bulk selection'
```

No API or database implementation changes. No commit or push.
